request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. The input is only a quality and tactile-material reference. Completely reimagine Buki's first screen as a sunny premium clay-and-paper product for children. Use exact text "Buki" centered in a friendly custom rounded wordmark, with the dot of the i becoming a tiny sun bead. Replace the old horizontal line and flower with a wide sunrise arc behind the wordmark, made from two clean colored bands and ending in a compact three-ray sparkle mark rather than a literal flower. Integrate the brand header into the top edge of the sketchpad instead of leaving a large separate header zone. The portrait blank drawing page should have a softly arched top cover, seven chunky peg bindings, precise dot grid, inset artwork-safe border, two small side bookmarks, and premium layered paper edges. Palette: tomato #F2694F, golden honey #F4B53F, deep teal #177B76, powder blue #77AADB, charcoal navy #294153, vanilla #FFF4DE. Put a small rounded-square camera control in a short bottom dock. Childy, sunny, modern, premium and buildable; no babyish cartoons. Blank page. Exact text only "Buki". No phone frame, no extra labels, no giant mascot, no photorealistic setting.
